before: With allowTextAfterFloatingTableBreak in compatibility mode 15, the text after a text-anchored floating table that broke across pages started on the page of its last fragment.
after: The text starts beside the first fragment, and every fragment wraps the text on its page. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
